scripts.build: npm run copy-vad-assets && tsc && vite build
scripts.pretest: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.pretest:watch: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.pretest:coverage: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.pretest:ui: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.test:store:win: vitest run tests/build-config.test.ts tests/windows-store-config.test.ts tests/windows-store-package.test.ts tests/windows-store-workflow.test.ts tests/unit/windowsPackageProbe.test.ts tests/unit/processTree.test.ts tests/unit/windowsJobOwnerSource.test.ts tests/unit/transcriptionJob.test.ts tests/unit/appShutdown.test.ts tests/unit/whisperService.test.ts tests/unit/localWhisperHandlers.test.ts tests/unit/transcriptionService.test.ts tests/startup-crash.test.ts tests/integration/processTree.windows.test.ts
scripts.lint:py: uv tool run --from ruff==0.15.1 ruff check scripts build && uv tool run --from ruff==0.15.1 ruff format --check scripts build
scripts.preelectron:dev: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.electron:dev: npm run copy-vad-assets && concurrently "vite --port 9527 --strictPort" "wait-on http://localhost:9527 && electron ."
scripts.preelectron:build: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.preelectron:build:win: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.preelectron:build:store:win: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.electron:build:store:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win appx --x64 --publish never --config build/electron-builder.microsoft-store.cjs
scripts.preelectron:build:mac: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm --ignore-scripts run electron:build:mac:arm64 && npm --ignore-scripts run electron:build:mac:x64
scripts.preelectron:build:mac:arm64: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.electron:build:mac:arm64: npm run build && AUDIOBASH_BUILD_MODE=development SKIP_NOTARIZE=true electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config.mac.identity=-
scripts.preelectron:build:mac:x64: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.electron:build:mac:x64: npm run build && AUDIOBASH_BUILD_MODE=development SKIP_NOTARIZE=true electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config.mac.identity=-
scripts.preelectron:build:mac:release:arm64: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.electron:build:mac:release:arm64: npm run build && AUDIOBASH_BUILD_MODE=release electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never --config.forceCodeSigning=true
scripts.preelectron:build:mac:release:x64: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
scripts.electron:build:mac:release:x64: npm run build && AUDIOBASH_BUILD_MODE=release electron-builder --mac --x64 --publish never --config.forceCodeSigning=true
scripts.preelectron:build:linux: npm run prepare:native && npm run prepare:electron
